title: We Are The Champions
summary: Religious victory with Zoroastrianism as your dominant religion while suzerain of Zanzibar.
author: hand
tips: Duel maps allow two religions, so you are not racing for the only prophet. Avoid Saladin (Arabia reserves a prophet).
If the AI founds first and takes the Zoroastrianism name, restart.
Unverified: a custom-named religion may not count as Zoroastrianism.

steps.text: Lobby: Zanzibar is the only city-state in the pool
steps.detail: Advanced Setup → City-States: deselect all, select Zanzibar. Turn off non-religious victories.
Scout early. If it never spawned, restart now while it is cheap.
Pick the name Zoroastrianism in the founding screen.

steps.text: Make it dominant in your own cities
steps.detail: Your civ must count as following your religion.
Send envoys; Tamar gets a bonus envoy when the city-state follows her religion.
Apostles with Debater/Proselytizer, then Missionaries to finish.

steps.text: Win while still suzerain of Zanzibar
steps.detail: Check suzerainty on the turn before the final conversion.
